name: Aisha al-Taymuriyya
shortBio: Egyptian trilingual philosopher-poet and Nahda pioneer whose treatise Mir’at al-Ta’ammul fi al-Umur (The Mirror of Contemplation) critiqued male misreadings of Qur’anic guardianship and defended women’s moral and rational parity.
centralQuestion: Does Qur’anic ethics ordain male social tyranny, or have men misappropriated religious authority by neglecting their ethical duties and denying women education?

keyWorks.title: Mir'at al-Ta'ammul fi al-Umur (The Mirror of Contemplation in Matters)
keyWorks.description: Pioneering Islamic feminist exegesis challenging patriarchal interpretations of qiwamah and advocating women’s intellectual formation.
